summary: Master Smart Tourism Trends and digital destination management. Learn to use AI, Big Data, and IoT to build sustainable, resilient tourism ecosystems.
lede: Smart Tourism: Trends and Future Directions shows professionals how to combine digital technologies, data, and physical infrastructure to create more efficient, sustainable, and personalized visitor journeys. The course connects destination management with the needs of digitally connected travelers while addressing overtourism and the pressure for measurable results. Across five days, you will assess digital maturity, integrate real-time data, map stakeholder ecosystems, apply AI-driven personalization, and measure sustainable impact. Practical work includes building a Smart Destination Roadmap, designing a visitor sentiment dashboard, using Destination Management Systems, and creating a data governance framework that supports collaboration despite budget, infrastructure, privacy, and stakeholder challenges.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is essential for professionals tasked with modernizing destination management and enhancing the digital visitor journey.
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in tourism management, urban planning, or digital marketing. Familiarity with basic data analysis and destination marketing concepts is required. No prior coding or technical engineering knowledge is necessary.
